daily.today_energy: Your grounded energy is calling you to slow down and actually savor the little things today. There's magic in the mundane, and the universe is rewarding your patience with quiet clarity.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your person needs to hear something real from you today. Single? Someone's been lowkey noticing your vibe. Either way, authenticity is your love language right now.
daily.career: Your ideas have weight today. Don't sleep on that thing you've been sitting on—it's the right moment to speak up. Your confidence is literally contagious to the people around you.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding activities: walks, stretching, literally touching grass. Your nervous system will thank you for slowing down instead of pushing harder.

weekly.overview: Mercury's vibes are shifting your perspective this week, Taurus. You're ready to release what no longer serves and make space for something fresh. Trust the timing—your intuition is absolutely locked in right now.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, vulnerability is your superpower this week. Someone might surprise you with their realness, and honestly? That's the energy you've been manifesting. Let your guard down a little.
weekly.career: Your creative solutions are hitting different this week. Don't sleep on that idea you've been sitting with—it's got legs. This is your moment to show what you're capable of without needing external validation.
